title: Mirrorball
description: A mirrorball on pure black, lit by one spotlight shining through a record sleeve. Every mirror carries a fragment of the cover, so Sgt. Pepper, Abbey Road or Help! scatters across the dark in its own colours. Throw it into a spin and the spots sweep past the type.
intent: One optical object finished to the edge: each facet is a real mirror, the spots are computed reflections of one lamp on a flat black backdrop that slide continuously as the ball turns, and their colours come from the album you pick.
